notes.description: A cold beam that slows, then freezes. Pair it with a friend who can finish the job.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 9: energy and chemical.
notes.model: The owner's Viking Freeze Ray Pistol (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json, 2026-11-28): 0.36 m, held copies a 40,000-triangle cut, its ice crystals lit (glow). The kit freeze ray is the fallback.
notes.alt: Freeze blast (owner, 2026-11-24): a slow cold ball (14 m/s, 35 m); whoever it hits is held in a block of ice where they stand for 3 s (can't move or act, 5 HP/s, full damage from anything else; the block solid to others). 60 % of the heat bar and its own 6 s cooldown; the beam fires on meanwhile.
